name: Kajima Motoaki
source:
"Don't think you can escape."

Occupation: University Student (On Leave)

Mendere!! Terrifying Man of Love and Hate!

Your ex-boyfriend from high school whom you broke up with one-sidedly. He was very restrictive and mentally unstable to begin with, and it only intensified when you two broke up. He has been chasing you all over the country and has been following you to the end of the world with hatred, saying "Even though I loved you so much...". He's still hungering to get back together with you, but his parents only allowed him to move out on the condition that he goes to a psychiatrist because every time he ruminates about the fact that he was abandoned, he wants to die.

   He has known you since junior high, and you two started dating in high school. From the beginning, he was willing to do anything, but couldn't really get an ok from you so you two ended up french kissing only halfway into the relationship.

   He has strong feelings of resentment towards you and repeatedly self-mutilates in an attempt to make you feel guilty. He's losing his temper, but he still loves you deeply.

[From [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSu7150SDXuZba2G8DBYb6H0YWjtYmx93Lq_TBfOxvRv1ksEgfrQx41V8_wPZVIz42duEV9qn35bP26/pub]Doropyan's blog[/url]]
